description: This file defines the MultivariateOnlineSummarizer class in Apache Spark's MLlib, which computes online statistical summaries (mean, variance, min, max, etc.) for vectors, supporting merging and weighted instances.

classes.name: MultivariateOnlineSummarizer
classes.description: Implements online computation of multivariate statistical summaries for vectors, supporting merging, weighted samples, and providing various statistical metrics.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds a new vector sample (with optional weight) to the summarizer, updating statistical metrics.

methods.name: merge
methods.description: Merges another MultivariateOnlineSummarizer into this one, combining their statistical summaries.

methods.name: mean
methods.description: Returns the mean vector of the added samples.

methods.name: variance
methods.description: Returns the unbiased variance vector of the added samples.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of samples added.

methods.name: weightSum
methods.description: Returns the sum of weights of all added samples.

methods.name: numNonzeros
methods.description: Returns the count of non-zero elements per dimension.

methods.name: max
methods.description: Returns the maximum value per dimension.

methods.name: min
methods.description: Returns the minimum value per dimension.

methods.name: normL2
methods.description: Returns the Euclidean norm per dimension.

methods.name: normL1
methods.description: Returns the L1 norm per dimension.
